parsed.text: Current distributions in both panels (p0, p1) are uniform across all four nodes for both red and blue: every grid cell is a peak. Conditional candidate records differ only at node n2. For command k0 (both panels) blue peaks span the upper-right 2x2 block (rows 0-1, cols 2-3) while red peaks span the upper-left 2x2 block (rows 0-1, cols 0-1). For command k1 (both panels) blue peaks at n2 concentrate on cell (0,2) and red peaks on cell (0,1). Command k2 candidate records at n2 are uniform like the current records. These candidate records are conditional estimates, not events that have occurred; copied prior records are not new estimates.
